text: Comms panel: after scrolling, the sticky 'Fire recall beam' card sits over the info cards with a semi-transparent background, so text from the cards behind ('speed.', 'CAPSULE · WHAT YOU SEE') shows through around its top edge.

Comms deadline arithmetic is inconsistent: the bar reads 'Since her mayday: 9 s. The beam must leave within 41 s' (sums to 50; earlier '1 s ... 49 s'), while WREN's subtitle on screen says 'the beam must leave within 49 seconds of her mayday'. A player trying to cut it fine cannot tell if the window is 49 or 50 s.

After the rescue objective completed (tick 2675) there is no objective on screen at all; Ines docks (~tick 4055) and the helm still says 'Descent is locked for now' with no hint of what unlocks it. Over 2000 ticks with no goal; I tried the helm twice. Story beats (cutscenes) only seemed to fire right after I left a console with Esc.

Helm panel: the 'Far-away clocks run ×1.054' headline number pops in a few seconds after the panel opens and pushes the 'Hold station at' slider down ~70 px; my click aimed at the slider (760,317) landed on the clock-rate bar instead and did nothing. Values first show as '-' placeholders.
